title: From a finite subgroup of $SO(3)$:$C_2$ leads to a Holant dichotomy
abstract: arXiv:2611.24236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Counting complexity within the Holant framework has been extensively studied through complexity dichotomy theorems. While substantial progress has been achieved for various restricted settings, the general complex-valued even-arity case without auxiliary unary signatures remains largely open. This paper studies a fundamental case in this program where the binary signatures induce a group structure satisfying \(M(B(\mathcal{F}))\cong C_2\). It is observed that projective equivalence classes of binary signature matrices naturally embed into finite subgroups of \(SO(3)\), providing an algebraic viewpoint for structural classification. This paper further identifies two fundamentally different regimes for the \(C_2\) case, namely the normal and isotropic cases, and analyzes their complexity behavior separately. translated_title: 来自SO(3)的有限子群：C₂引出Holant二分定理
translated_abstract: 计数复杂性在Holant框架中已通过复杂性二分定理得到广泛研究。尽管在各种受限设置下已取得实质性进展，但在没有辅助一元签名的复值偶数元一般情形下，该问题仍基本悬而未决。本文研究了该研究计划中的一个基本情形，即二元签名诱导出满足 M(B(𝓕)) ≅ C₂ 的群结构。我们观察到二元签名矩阵的射影等价类自然地嵌入到SO(3)的有限子群中，为结构分类提供了一个代数视角。本文进一步识别出C₂情形下两个根本不同的模式，即正规情形和各向同性情形，并分别分析了它们的复杂性行为。结合gadget构造、分解技术、插值论证，以及一种将……转换为实数的实数化方法
tldr: 该论文提出二元签名矩阵的射影等价类可自然嵌入SO(3)的有限子群这一代数视角，据此将C₂情形划分为正规与各向同性两类，并综合运用gadget构造、分解、插值与实数化技术，证明了复值偶数元Holant框架下的复杂性二分定理。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a Holant dichotomy for the C₂ case by showing that projective equivalence classes of binary signature matrices naturally embed into finite subgroups of SO(3), splitting the problem into normal and isotropic regimes and combining gadget constructions, decomposition, interpolation, and a real-numberization approach.
